description: This file implements a component object for a BSP engine writer, specifically the creation, initialization, and removal functions for the string component object. It defines functions for object lifecycle management and basic method setup for writing various data types, as well as opening, closing, and content retrieval operations.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE BspTemplateWriterCOCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new BSP Template Writer component object, allocating memory and setting function pointers.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BspTemplateWriterCORemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the BSP Template Writer component object, freeing allocated memory.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BspTemplateWriterCOInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the component object, setting up function pointers for various write operations and other controls.
